text:
Iris (Design): dropped a new tiny-flow in Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/new/onboard-probe 
Iris (Design): idea: lightweight "language probe" that scans repo filenames and surfaces a single, high-signal starter card in the header. keeps the page tidy.
Ben (PM): goal = get users into a runnable demo with one clear action. what's the rollback if probe misfires?
Iris (Design): show a small 'Not this? Browse all' and a 'Why this?' tooltip explaining heuristics. also a 'hide suggestions' action for the session.
Kai (Engineering): plan: run a client-only probe (filenames + top-level manifests). return up to 2 candidates; if ambiguous show both. no backend calls unless user selects starter.
Zo (DevEx): perf/UX: probe runs after page paint, show a card skeleton first. swap cards with a fade so there is no layout jump.
Marta (A11y): important: do NOT move focus on passive auto-update. Use aria-live="polite" to announce "Starter suggestions ready". If user clicks 'Detect now', then focus should move to the primary CTA after replacement.
Iris (Design): copy candidates for the banner: "We detected starters that match this repo. Try one to get running fast." shorter: "Suggested starter for this repo."
Ben (PM): also show a tiny runtime estimate chip: 'Quick (<5m)' or 'Setup (~10m)'. label as estimate. UX should make it obvious it's approximate.
Kai (Engineering): runtime is a heuristic: check scripts or presence of Dockerfile/envs. monorepos are a special case 12 show a path hint (e.g., pkg/api).
Zo (DevEx): privacy blurb: "We inspect filenames in your browser to suggest starters 12 nothing is uploaded." legal wants that exact phrasing in full doc. short UI variant: 'We analyze filenames locally.'
Marta (A11y): accessibility checklist: 1) aria-live status message, 2) sr-only explanatory text for the 'Why this?' tooltip, 3) keyboard order stable during update, 4) tags not conveyed by color alone.
Iris (Design): visual tweak: small language pill (e.g., 'Node') + 'Also: Python' if multiple. clicking language shows alternative card list. pills should be accessible buttons with aria-pressed.
Ben (PM): metric events: probe_shown, probe_clicked, probe_skipped. keep events anonymous by default, opt-in for detailed telemetry.
Kai (Engineering): session behavior: remember 'Hide suggestions' in sessionStorage. if they opt into personalization, persist to account preferences.
Zo (DevEx): edge-case: repo with no manifests -> show popular starters and a 'Browse all' CTA. do not present an empty zone.
Marta (A11y): for the keyboard flows: arrow keys to move between cards, Enter to trigger, Esc to close the expanded view. ensure visible focus styles.
Iris (Design): I'll update the figma with explicit sr-only copy and the small privacy link. will post a new prototype this afternoon. anyone want to pair on screen reader pathing?
Zo (DevEx): I can pair tomorrow morning. will also spike the in-browser parser.
onboard-bot: Preview for feature/onboard-language-probe is live -> https://preview.redwood.ai/language-probe (staging)
Ben (PM): thanks all 17 filing follow-ups: legal sign-off on privacy copy, a11y preflight, spike branch for client probe.
Iris (Design): closing loop 12 will ping when updated. :sparkles:
